hooks.command: /bin/sh -c 'DCG="${HOME}/.local/share/mise/shims/dcg"; [ -x "$DCG" ] || DCG="/opt/mise/shims/dcg"; [ -x "$DCG" ] || DCG="$(command -v dcg 2>/dev/null || true)"; [ -x "$DCG" ] || { echo "dcg not found: run mise install (guard fails closed)" >&2; exit 2; }; exec "$DCG" --agent claude-code'
